# Swag Stree

> Premium fashion e-commerce store in India — kurtas, coord sets, sarees, ethnic wear, streetwear & accessories. COD, UPI, Paytm, Google Pay, fast pan-India delivery.

## Brand & discovery
- Brand names: Swag Stree, Swagstree, swag stree fashion, swagstree.com

- Languages: English (India), en-IN

## Shopping & payments
- Cash on Delivery (COD) across India
- UPI, Paytm, Google Pay for prepaid orders
- Guest checkout supported
- Delivery notes at checkout; editable until order ships
- Order tracking via account (email / phone)

## URL patterns
- Home: /
- Product: /?id={productId}
- Product with variant: /?id={productId}&color={color}&size={size}
- Category browse: /?category={category-slug}
- Search: /?q={search-term}
